title: Nazil Hai Karbala Me Nawasa Rasool ka
body:
Hussain ya hussain
hussain shaafi, hussain kaafi..(2)
nazil hai karbala mein nawasa rasool ka..(2)
Parcham khula hua hai hussaini asool ka
nazil hai karbala mein nawasa rasool ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hai akhri salam ko akbar jhuke hue..(2)
naksha bana hua hai ruku e rasool ka
ya hussain
hussain shaafi, hussain kaafi..(2)
nazil hai karbala mein nawasa rasool ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jo hurmala ke teer ko asghar ne di shikast..(2)
ab bal nikal gaya hai umayya ki bhool ka
ya hussain
hussain shaafi, hussain kaafi..(2)
nazil hai karbala mein nawasa rasool ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Allah ki kul raza ka malik mera hussain..(2)
matlab ye hai nabi ke sajde mein tool ka
ya hussain
hussain shaafi, hussain kaafi..(2)
nazil hai karbala mein nawasa rasool ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hai paani band malik e kausar ki aal par..(2)
mu'n dekhti hai bibiya'n zahra ke phool ka
ya hussain
hussain shaafi, hussain kaafi..(2)
nazil hai karbala mein nawasa rasool ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Munkir nakeer mujhse jo kuch sadaa..(2)
keh dunga nauhagar hu janabe batool ka
ya hussain
hussain shaafi, hussain kaafi..(2)
nazil hai karbala mein nawasa rasool ka..(2)
